title: Query ICI Diagnostic Logs
description: Query Cloud Logging for `XLA_SDC_CHECKER`, `ICI transfer wait`, and `Wait timeout on sflag` logs emitted by XLA ICI straggler instrumentation (`ici-sdc-test` configured with `xla_tpu_enable_sdc_checker=true`, `xla_tpu_sdc_check_repeat_count=0`, `xla_tpu_sdc_check_halt_on_detection=false`, `xla_tpu_ici_sdc_test_max_distance=1`, `xla_tpu_ici_sdc_test_pipeline_depth=13`, `xla_tpu_ici_sdc_test_buffer_size_chunks=256`, `xla_tpu_ici_sdc_test_packet_size_chunks=256`, `xla_tpu_ici_sdc_test_iterations=5000`, `xla_tpu_ici_sdc_test_run_on_program_start=true`, `xla_tpu_enable_log_recorder=true`, `xla_tpu_ici_sdc_test_sflag_wait_timeout_ms=5`, surfaced via XSC/LLO Logger callbacks or MXLA coordinator debug callbacks).
instruction: python3 tools/scripts/pull_and_format_logs.py --project_id=${project_id} --workload_name=${workload_name} --last_occurrence=${last_occurrence} --start="${start}" --end="${end}" --restart_attempt=${restart_attempt} --output_file=${output_file} --limit=${limit} --filter_extra="\"XLA_SDC_CHECKER\" OR \"ICI transfer wait\" OR \"Wait timeout on sflag\"" --unmask=true --deduplicate=false

restart_attempt.description: JobSet restart attempt index (optional, default -1 to query all attempts across the window).

last_occurrence.description: Optional timestamp baseline; defaults to current UTC time if omitted.

output_file.description: Output path for unmasked ICI diagnostic logs.
